graph_provenance.notes: NPU part: onnx_graph_walk of the real exported graph (263 ONNX nodes, 30 metadata nodes dropped, 114 activations fused, 111 ops kept). dtype int8 is a deployment assumption (W8A8, int32 bias); the export itself is fp32. Layers follow ultralytics module index (model.N), Detect head split per branch. CPU post-processing is analytic_count with assumptions: 200 pre-NMS candidates, 8 objects, 3600 depth px per crop, 5 ICP iterations. Output [1, 84, 8400]. This file is a renamed copy of T2_detect for the overhead camera (scenario S2).

setup.bandwidth_mode: CALC (SCALE-Sim stall-free; stall_cycles_scalesim is 0 by construction)
setup.stall_model: stall_cycles_bw_model = max(0, dram_bytes / per_tile_bw - vx1_cycles), per_tile_bw = 28.44 B/cycle (DRAM peak / NPU clock / tiles)
setup.counts: SRAM reads/writes in words; DRAM in bytes (int8 1 B, bf16/fp32 2 B words)
setup.not_covered: elementwise, norm, softmax, pool, resize, memcopy, cpu/dsp kernels are not systolic GEMMs and stay on the L0/L1 NPU model
